assumptions.conditionalNodeQuotient: If C physically across selected L, C.first=L.first=U; C.second=L.second=V. Component labels do NOT establish distinct sources.
assumptions.conditionalDiodeModel: Four zero-drop ideal diodes, all anodes on selected U and/or V, all cathodes at P, instantaneous resistive load P-M, no output smoothing bank and no spark-gap conduction in selected forward test
assumptions.drivingSine: x sin(theta) ideal half-source voltage with x>0 and theta in [0,2*pi]; selected source does not change when load is connected
assumptions.caseClassification: The speaker's 'selected coil' may be whole A-B symmetric centre-tapped winding, only A-M half-section, or independent coil with unresolved M relationship. These are not source-verified actual wiring.

hypotheses.coilSpan: U=A, V=B, M symmetric winding midpoint
hypotheses.forward: P-M=max(0,+x sin theta,-x sin theta)=x abs(sin theta)
hypotheses.qualifiedMeaning: requires complementary U/V voltage phases relative to M, not simply two physical component names
satisfies four packages but only one distinct electrical input
physically opposite capacitor/coil ends STILL fail to guarantee full-wave if the selected coil is only half winding
same output as H2 under bare ideal assumptions

idealUnfilteredPredictions.withSamePeak: T2 has twice the DC mean and twice the resistive output power compared with T1/H2/H1; RMS factor sqrt(2)
idealUnfilteredPredictions.interpretation: Cannot assign these values to narrated ~4kV or separate-reel ~3.8V/0.4W without original exact terminals, time, load and waveform.

sourceCurrentIdentifiability.oppositeDiodeGroups: Incidence [[1,1,0,0],[0,0,1,1]] has rank 2/nullity 2: individual parallel package currents cannot be inferred from total branch current without additional resistive/dynamic constitutive laws
sourceCurrentIdentifiability.oneDiodeInputGroup: Incidence [[1,1,1,1]] has rank 1/nullity 3, even less package-level inverse information
sourceCurrentIdentifiability.peakOnly: All four ideal examples share peak x, so peak-output label is not a graph discriminator
sourceCurrentIdentifiability.negativeHalfPositiveCurrent: Within exact ideal unsmoothed fixed-sinusoidal hypotheses this implies T2 (full winding AND opposite electrical input nodes); neither 'two off cap' nor 'across coil' alone implies T2.
sourceCurrentIdentifiability.storedOutputCounterexample: An output storage capacitor remaining charged when diode input is zero can make one-input half-wave rectification appear as continuous positive DC; Coutput dV/dt=-V/R during diode-off, Uout=0.5 Coutput V^2, dUout/dt=-V^2/R. A spark gap or different source waveform invalidates simple statistical discrimination.
sourceCurrentIdentifiability.unmodelled: diode forward drops and recovery, transformer winding mutual inductance, nonlinear/time-varying driver, spark gap, source retarded response, shunt conductance or antiresonant LC loading, actual grounding and environmental power.

acceptance.formalStatus: Finite Agda source written; no Agda kernel executed, physical source model cannot be admitted
acceptance.originalEvidence: Prior source archive still 0/24 raw device evidence roles, and no source-to-pin continuity has been authenticated.

reverseNext: First determine whether selected capacitor/coil is across A-B FULL secondary or A-M HALF section; this is independent of the component terminal quotient.
Then determine each forward diode's actual anode node (two U/two V versus four U) and cathode joined P, including whether physical packages share current.
Only THEN compare measured P-to-M signed electrical waveform, ideally with storage and spark dynamics modelled; peak-only measurements cannot discriminate ideal T2 vs T1.
Source-origin claim requires simultaneous signed original driver, environment/earth/chemical/RF, load and storage work. Other Filsinger reels cannot be merged.
safety: Historical source and mathematical inverse study only; not HV build, direct test or probing instructions.
